description: Scoring rubric for Product Manager roles. Edit weights and descriptions to tune scoring without touching code. All weight_percent values across all criteria must sum to 100.

criteria.name: AI/ML Technical Depth
criteria.description: Deep understanding of LLMs, RAG, agents, NLP, and data pipelines as explicitly requested by the JD.

criteria.name: Product Lifecycle & Agile
criteria.description: Experience with roadmapping, sprint planning, user stories, A/B testing, and agile frameworks.

criteria.name: Enterprise/SaaS Architecture
criteria.description: Experience with scalable software, API integrations, cloud infrastructure, and B2B platforms.

criteria.name: Seniority & Target Role Match
criteria.description: Candidate is targeting AI Director or AI Manager in Product roles. Deduct maximum points (score 0 for this criterion) if the JD is for a Product Owner (PO), Junior PM, or individual contributor mid-level role, even if the candidate has the skills.

criteria.name: Industry / Domain Fit
criteria.description: Matches the specific industry or domain requested by the JD (e.g., Healthcare, FinTech, E-commerce, Biotech).

criteria.name: Education & Certifications
criteria.description: Possesses relevant degrees (e.g., CS, Business) and certifications (e.g., CSPO, PMP) requested by the JD.

criteria.name: Cross-functional Leadership
criteria.description: Leading engineering, design, and data science teams, specifically in 0-to-1 environments without direct authority.

criteria.name: Commercial Impact
criteria.description: Proven ROI, user retention metrics, revenue growth, and Go-To-Market strategy formulation.

criteria.name: Stakeholder Management
criteria.description: Executive communication, client-facing experience, and driving cross-team alignment.

criteria.name: Problem Solving & Ambiguity
criteria.description: Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and define complex systems.
